visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a high-angle shot of various types of toasted bread and buns arranged on a wire cooling rack atop a wooden surface. To the left is a thick slice of chocolate-colored toast, and in the center sits a round bun topped with brown crumbles. On the right, a square of white toast features a creamy swirl. Three white ceramic mugs with the black 'SAKImoto' logo are positioned in the blurred background under bright indoor lighting. (2) The scene shifts to a detailed close-up of a printed menu or flyer titled '生吐司放題' (All-you-can-eat Shokupan), displaying multiple photos of different bread varieties and price information. A finger points to specific sections of the text. This is followed by a screen capture of a Facebook post from the SAKImoto Bakery page, detailing anniversary promotional events. (3) A young man with dark hair and glasses, wearing a light grey sweatshirt, appears sitting at a restaurant table. He is shown taking a bite of a piece of bread and then drinking from a white mug. Two wire racks with pieces of bread are in front of him. The background is a clean, modern cafe interior with soft lighting. (4) The camera shows staff members behind a white counter. Two workers, a man and a woman, are dressed in white t-shirts, beige aprons, and yellow headbands. They are busy preparing orders and handling bread. A shot shows a hand holding a printed paper receipt from a bank. (5) Several close-up shots follow: bread slices are placed onto a metal tray and slid into a stainless steel toaster oven; a television screen on the wall displays a man speaking in a corporate interview style. The man with glasses continues to eat and talk, showing the interior texture of a chocolate shokupan and a taro-filled white shokupan as he breaks them apart by hand. (6) The video concludes with an exterior shot of the SAKImoto Bakery storefront, featuring a glass facade with the brand name in black lettering and outdoor seating. The final shot is a close-up of the man dipping a piece of chocolate bread into a mug of milk or tea.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 大家知道最近 日本的高級生吐司 專賣店 舉辦了 內用吃到飽的 活動嗎. (2) [Slogan]: 生吐司放題 90分鐘吃到飽. [Logo]: @SAKImoto Bakery. (3) [Variety]: 透過電話預約 都能吃90分鐘的 內用麵包吃到飽. (4) [Subtitle]: 裡面能吃到 18款的麵包 跟 7款飲品 一個人的費用是 $399元. (5) [Subtitle]: 不過這個吃到飽 有非常多的限制 一個人一次只能點 一杯飲料 一片生吐司 跟 兩個小麵包. (6) [Slogan]: 如果餐點有浪費的話 一個人會再多收 300元. (11) [Variety]: YouTube搜尋 吃貨豪豪.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a first-person review and informative guide for a limited-time 'All-you-can-eat' shokupan (raw toast) event at SAKImoto Bakery in Taipei. It aims to inform viewers of the promotional price, variety, and booking process while providing a realistic account of the service speed and ordering limitations based on the creator's personal experience.
